milestone.title: consumer-surface hygiene for repo-internal skill — relocate mp-code-review into docs/internal or make paths relative

intent.outcome: The repo-internal mp-code-review skill is unambiguously repo-only: copies to downstream repos cannot break, the consumer-surface-lint no longer has to special-case it, and the audit trail (which lessons catalog + patterns file is canonical) is explicit.

problem.description: templates/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md is currently excluded from consumer-surface-lint via EXCLUDE_PATHS in scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh:59 — but the file is full of internal vocabulary: 8+ references to L\d+ lesson codes (lines 3,18,19,46-51,67,74-76,83,131-132), M\d+ milestone ids (line 20 references M173 S1, line 43 'Lessons with runnable Pattern: blocks (M173 S1)'), and 5 references to a repo-internal path `crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md` (lines 11,18,66,116,131). The exclusion is intentional (the skill is master-plan-repo-only; see its own header), but if a future maintainer copies this skill into an adopter repo, the prose breaks with dead links and confusing identifiers. The current lint only catches leaks from the SHIPPED skills; nothing structurally enforces 'this skill must not be downstream-able'.

in_scope: Move templates/skills/mp-code-review/ → docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/ (and update AGENTS.md, docs/skills/README.md, plus the few references in templates/harness/cursor/agents/mp-planner.md and templates/harness/opencode/agents/mp-planner.md) so the EXCLUDE_PATHS no longer needs a templates/-side exception.

Replace 5 hardcoded `crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md` and `crates/mp/tests/code_review_patterns.rs` paths in the SKILL.md with a single relative-link convention (e.g. `${REPO_ROOT}/crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md`) plus a sentence explaining adopters must resolve the variable, OR drop the prose path references and rely on the canonical doc-map at docs/skills/README.md.
Add a `PROVENANCE: REPO-ONLY — NOT INSTALLABLE` header to docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md so a casual reader knows not to ship it.
Remove the EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out for templates/skills/mp-code-review/ from scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh, and verify the lint remains clean.
Add a CHANGELOG entry recording the move.
out_of_scope: Rewriting the lesson catalog body (the L1-L63 content stays as-is).
Touching the runnable patterns (crates/mp/tests/code_review_patterns.rs) — they are tests and live where they belong.
Removing the EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out for any other skill (currently only mp-code-review is exempted).

acceptance_criteria.description: The mp-code-review skill lives at docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/ with a PROVENANCE header; the templates/-side exception is gone.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e templates/skills/mp-code-review && test -e docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md && head -10 docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md includes 'PROVENANCE: REPO-ONLY'.

acceptance_criteria.description: scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh no longer carves out a templates/skills/mp-code-review path; the lint runs against the moved file's new home and still passes (because the new home is under docs/internal which is already excluded or via the same rule that excludes it).
The SKILL.md prose no longer hardcodes `crates/mp/...` paths; the remaining repo-internal references are either relative or templated.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -n 'crates/mp/(tests|src)/' docs/internal/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md returns at most the canonical-relative anchors and not raw absolute repo paths.

acceptance_criteria.description: make lint and consumer-surface-lint remain clean; the canonical install-smoke contract still rejects mp-code-review from a registered install.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make lint && make consumer-surface-lint && cargo nextest run -p mp --test install_skills_v2 --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/internal_skill/)' (existing negative tests pass; if the test names an absolute path, update them to the new home).

work_packages.rollback: Restore templates/skills/mp-code-review; restore scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out

work_packages.name: Lint + content cleanup
work_packages.goal: Drop EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out; replace 5 hardcoded  paths with relative anchors; verify consumer-surface-lint remains clean
work_packages.rollback: Re-add EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out; restore hardcoded paths

Run make lint plus consumer-surface-lint plus install-skills-v2 contract.
